text.text_excerpt: Excellent. Excellent service, excellent coffee, excellent dessert, excellent location. I was in the area and had a few minutes to kill between appointments so I pulled up to CR and thought I'd give them a try. I was greeted warmly by the barista, who made me a delicious vanilla iced latte. I also picked up a locally made, fresh as it gets moon pie for my daughter. I sat on the porch to take a load off and unwind for a sec. What a welcome break. Thanks to their great location on Magazine St. and to the beautiful weather of the day, I was able to people and puppy watch for a bit. Seriously, I hated to have to leave, but I'm sure I'll return. :) PS - the moon pie was a huge hit.

Coast Roast is my favorite coffee in the city. I frequent the St. Roch location often. The Auction House Market location is decent. When I heard they opened a new location Uptown, I was thrilled. They are located in a beautiful old shotgun double. They occupy the right side. There is a nice porch in the front with bar stools and you can sit and enjoy the ambiance. It was fun to catch some of the Saints game on the old black and white tv inside. My go to drink is the iced latte. The barista prepared it very well. They have a variety of drinks choose to choose from , as well as a small assortment of pastries and sandwiches. I'm sure I will be back soon! P.S. Another perk of Coast Roast is t...

On a walk today to exercise and run an errand and I got so hot I needed frozen coffee, stat. Luckily I passed by this place and noticed I could order online and pick up on a shelf inside. Perfect for me, as I hadn't brought my mask on my walk. In less than 5 minutes, I had the most delicious frozen coffee and felt totally rejuvenated. There's a ton of covered outdoor seating, perfect for Magazine Street people watching, and it's super charming. They also sell bags of coffee beans. Definitely pop in and try this place!
